Body.Content:
Azure Confidential Ledger provides cryptographic evidence that blockchain ledgers have not been tampered with.

  • Stored data is cryptographically verifiable, both governance and transaction
  • Utilizes an open-source CCF network (permissioned blockchain)
  • Runs within confidential computing – i.e. hardware rooted secure enclaves
  • Provides flexibility to opt-in or opt-out of Trusted Computing Base 
  • Provides access to performant infrastructure without the hassles
  • CIOs and CTOs can use Confidential Ledger when engaging with low-trust organizations
  • CIOs and CTOs can use this solution to minimize security risks/breaches, especially for metadata integrity

Learn more.
